external_only_references.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2667 on digitalisation of the visa procedure
external_only_references.review_state: Official English EUR-Lex text and instrument identity reviewed on 2026-10-23; the German EUR-Lex route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. This is an amending act, not a consolidated Visa Code. Article 8(2) makes general application depend on the Commission decision under Article 7(1), while Article 8(3) lists earlier application dates. Verify the Commission decision and any Austrian notification before describing the EU Visa Application Platform as operational. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

external_only_references.title: Regulation (EU) 2016/1191 simplifying requirements for certain public documents
external_only_references.review_state: The official English text and Article 2 scope were reviewed on 2026-10-23. It covers specified Member-State public documents, including marriage and parentage records; Article 2(3) excludes third-country public documents and Article 2(4) excludes recognition of the legal effects of another Member State's document. The German route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

external_only_references.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2685 on digitalisation of the visa procedure
external_only_references.review_state: Official English text and instrument identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. This amending act changes the uniform visa format to a digital format, but Article 3 defers general application to a Commission implementing decision under Article 2(1), with a limited exception for Article 1 point 2 from 27 December 2023. Check the decision in the Official Journal before describing digital visas as operational. This is not a consolidated text of Regulation (EC) No 1683/95. The German route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

external_only_references.title: Regulation (EU) 2018/1240 establishing ETIAS
external_only_references.review_state: EUR-Lex identifies the current consolidated version dated 12 June 2026. Article 2(1)(c) covers visa-exempt third-country family members of Union citizens or equivalent free-movement beneficiaries who lack the specified residence card or permit; Article 2(2)(b)-(c) excludes qualifying cardholders. On 2026-10-23 the official ETIAS FAQ said the system was not operating and no applications were being collected; the Commission scheduled launch for Q4 2026 without an exact date. Recheck official operational status and the actual residence document before applying. The German route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.
